title: Among male patients with abnormal platelet counts (PLT < 150 or PLT > 350)
question: Among male patients with abnormal platelet counts (PLT < 150 or PLT > 350) and normal white blood cell levels (3.5 < WBC < 9.0), identify each patient once using their most recent laboratory record. Return their ID, age, and diagnosis. Additionally, report the net difference between the number of such patients with low platelets (<150) and those with high platelets (>350).

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    p.XCL_058 AS patient_id,
    l.XCL_027 AS plt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.XCL_058 ORDER BY l.XCL_015 DESC) AS rn
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
  WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'M'
    AND (l.XCL_027 < 150 OR l.XCL_027 > 350)
    AND l.XCL_030 > 3.5
    AND l.XCL_030 < 9.0
),
latest AS (
  SELECT patient_id, plt
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  p.XCL_058 AS id,
  p.XCL_060 AS age,
  p.XCL_064 AS diagnosis
FROM latest l
JOIN Patient p ON p.XCL_058 = l.patient_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest WHERE plt < 150) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest WHERE plt > 350) AS net_difference,
  NULL,
  NULL

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    p.XCL_058 AS patient_id,
    l.XCL_027 AS plt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.XCL_058 ORDER BY l.XCL_015 DESC) AS rn
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
  WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'M'
    AND (l.XCL_027 < 150 OR l.XCL_027 > 350)
    AND l.XCL_030 > 3.5
    AND l.XCL_030 < 9.0
),
latest AS (
  SELECT patient_id, plt
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  p.XCL_058 AS id,
  p.XCL_060 AS age,
  p.XCL_064 AS diagnosis
FROM latest l
JOIN Patient p ON p.XCL_058 = l.patient_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest WHERE plt < 150) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest WHERE plt > 350) AS net_difference,
  NULL,
  NULL

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    p.XCL_058 AS id,
    p.XCL_060 AS age,
    p.XCL_064 AS diagnosis,
    l.XCL_026 AS plt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.XCL_058 ORDER BY l.XCL_015 DESC) AS rn
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
  WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'M'
    AND (l.XCL_026 < 150 OR l.XCL_026 > 350)
    AND l.XCL_021 > 3.5 AND l.XCL_021 < 9.0
),
latest AS (
  SELECT id, age, diagnosis, plt
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT id, age, diagnosis
FROM latest
UNION ALL
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest WHERE plt < 150) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest WHERE plt > 350) AS net_difference,
  NULL,
  NULL

WITH filtered_lab AS (
    SELECT
        l.XCL_014 AS patient_id,
        l.XCL_015 AS lab_date,
        l.XCL_020 AS plt,
        l.XCL_021 AS wbc
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE (l.XCL_020 < 150 OR l.XCL_020 > 350)
      AND l.XCL_021 > 3.5
      AND l.XCL_021 < 9.0
),
ranked_lab AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        lab_date,
        plt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY lab_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM filtered_lab
),
latest_lab AS (
    SELECT
        patient_id,
        plt
    FROM ranked_lab
    WHERE rn = 1
),
patient_info AS (
    SELECT
        p.XCL_058 AS patient_id,
        p.XCL_060 AS age,
        p.XCL_063 AS diagnosis
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.XCL_063 = 'M'
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        pi.patient_id,
        pi.age,
        pi.diagnosis,
        ll.plt
    FROM patient_info pi
    JOIN latest_lab ll ON pi.patient_id = ll.patient_id
)
SELECT
    patient_id,
    age,
    diagnosis,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM combined WHERE plt < 150) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM combined WHERE plt > 350) AS net_difference
FROM combined

    l.XCL_027 AS plt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.XCL_058 ORDER BY l.XCL_015 DESC) AS rn
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
  WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'M'
    AND (l.XCL_027 < 150 OR l.XCL_027 > 350)
    AND l.XCL_030 > 3.5
    AND l.XCL_030 < 9.0
),
latest AS (
  SELECT patient_id, plt
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  p.XCL_058 AS id,
  p.XCL_060 AS age,
  p.XCL_064 AS diagnosis
FROM latest l
JOIN Patient p ON p.XCL_058 = l.patient_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest WHERE plt < 150) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM latest WHERE plt > 350) AS net_difference,
  NULL,
  NULL
